uncertainties.note: The Siberian Railway Overman pursuer confronted in 4420-4431 is never named in these rows. The role matches Yassaba Jin (locked as the Siberian Railway squad commander), but identity is inferred from context only; kept gender-neutral ('that guy', 'they') rather than asserting Yassaba by name.
Turn-taking between the pursuer and Gain Bijou has no speaker tags in the source table; attribution is inferred from the 'Black Southern Cross' epithet (Gain's locked nickname) appearing in 4428.
Source row ends with the malformed, unpaired <ed(500)> (no matching <ab()>). Kept exactly as in the source rather than repaired, per the rule to flag rather than silently fix malformed commands.

Researched and confirmed: the Power Golem in this scene is piloted by Asuham Boone (not Yassaba Jin), and Karin is Karin Boone, Asuham's sister and Gain Bijou's former lover. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overman_King_Gainer , https://akurasu.net/wiki/Master_Characters_List , https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/%E3%83%91%E3%83%AF%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B4%E3%83%AC%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0 . Both names proposed for the glossary in batch_04398_glossary_proposals.json since this is their first appearance in the corpus so far translated.

'Dome police' translated literally as a generic descriptive phrase (not capitalized as a proper noun); no dedicated English source names a distinct 'Dome Police' organization, so it is not proposed as a locked glossary term.
'invader' (interbeeda) kept lowercase as an ad hoc taunt about the Dominator's flying-saucer shape, not a named enemy faction; see also the parallel uncertainty in batch_04478 (rows 4498/4504/4506).
